name: New Yorker
summary: Read New Yorker articles on the flip phone
description: Browse articles and read them in a layout built for the XP3800 screen and directional keys.
author: thooton

changes.text: Common: setup files written whole from any thread, leftover setup files cleaned up, and every app on common bumped.
Use common keypad and sizing helpers in existing UI consumers.
Build and publish immutable Wave package releases alongside the legacy channel.
Turn Android backup on in every app, so adb backup can move their data to another phone.
Articles end with one ink diamond, and leads without pictures, the menu and the Magazine behave.
A spinner while an article loads, not a half-drawn page.
Smaller scroll steps in lists and articles.
